title: Nue
summary: The last seal breaks. Seal the spirit, and bring Kagerou back.

lines: You came, and you brought everyone. Good. Someone should see this.
Kagerou, stop. It isn't too late.
It was too late the day they made me leave.
Five natures, bound in one. Wake, Nue!
The seal's broken! That chakra... it's inside him!
Clones everywhere! We've got them. {name}, the big one's yours!
Wear it down. When it breaks, I'll give you the seals. Go!
It's out of him, but it's loose! {name}: the Five-Nature Seal. Rat, Tiger, Dragon, Snake, Boar. Now!

beats.text: Weave the Five-Nature Seal: Rat, Tiger, Dragon, Snake, Boar (hold {weave}; {charge_chakra} charges chakra)

lines: ...It's quiet. For the first time in years, it's quiet.
You're still here, Kagerou. That's more than the Nue wanted.
Why stop it from taking me? I'd have deserved it.
Because you held back too, on the frozen road. I felt it.
The Watch can have him after the academy hears me speak for him. This time I won't stay quiet.
So... do we finally get our rematch?
Wear something you don't mind getting singed.
